rooms.name: The Field of Mars
rooms.desc:
You stand within the Campus Martia, the Field of Mars.
Martial statues and ivy-draped columns impart a sense of 
imperial majesty and splendor.  Chariots of gold and silver
and the arms of a thousand legions wait within the massive walls
of this godly field.

rooms.name: A field of wheat
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of the estate of Cedric the Saxon, just inside the gate.
A field of wheat lies here, sorted into carefully cultivated rows.  Filthy
farmhands toil about in quiet solemnity.  Wind whistles through the wheat,
across the still and endless prairie.  To the east, the gate leads to
freedom from this place, and in all other directions lie Cedric's lands.

rooms.name: Among the fields
rooms.desc:
The wheat field extends north here.  Overseers walk along the palisade,
keeping serfs in line.  Hands work the land, harvesting a petty crop.
Grains of wheat sway in the breeze, in their timeless prairie dance.
The palisade curves around to the west from the south here.

rooms.name: A peaceful vineyard
rooms.desc:
You stand within a great assortion of grapevines, arranged in
perfect rows by the peasantry.  Stands have been erected to guide
the vineyards to their ultimate growth.  The air smells of sweet grapes,
fermenting in the golden sun.  A thorny palisade to the north keeps the
peasants working the fields without hope of a better life, hemming in their
dreams by blocking the thought of freedom outside the walls.

rooms.name: A grazing pasture
rooms.desc:
You stand within a pasture fit for grazing animals.  Chaffs of
wheat flop tro and fro, swaying in harmony with the quiet prairie
breeze around the pasture.  Animals feed upon the long grasses and
from a community trough, basking in the sun in contentment of their
simple lives.

rooms.name: At the gate of a feudal manor
rooms.desc:
This is the outer gateway of a lordly manor house to the west.  A
sturdy palisade wall bristles with menacing wooden spears to the west.
running north and south past the gate.  Over the wall, you can see serfs
toiling at the earth and harvesting crops.  A dirt path leads through the
gate to the manor, but the gate itself is shut and locked, indicating
that the lord is not accepting visitors.

rooms.name: An apple orchard
rooms.desc:
A rustic apple orchard lies here in the corner of Cedric's estate.  The
trees are aligned in 3 straight rows of ten, and burst with a bounty of
fruit ripe for the picking.  The palisade curves to the west from the north,
extending toward the manor.  This is a nice, shady respite from the rest of
Cedric's crude estate.

rooms.name: A chicken coop
rooms.desc:
It is rather fowl in here, and rather foul as well.  Chickens are
unceremoniously arrayed in cages around a rectangular shed.  Hay lines the
floor, which is slathered with a slimy white ooze of chicken crap.  The noise
of clucking chickens, outraged and pleading their case to the world for rescue,
is palpably obnoxious.

rooms.name: A field of rutabagas
rooms.desc:
Turnips are aligned here in linear rows of fastidious design.
They smell of earthy freshness, and are in fine season.  The field
of sumptious rutabagas is fenced in by a palisade running east to west
from the south, ending in the stone wall which comprises the castle of 
old Cedric.

rooms.name: An orchard of tangerine trees
rooms.desc:
You stand within an orchard of tangerine trees, complemented by a
series of cumquat trees.  Red colored citrus fruit grows in abundance
among the trees of the orchard ready to be hand picked by various serfs.
The palisade runs north and south here, leading toward the gate which
extends into the castle of Cedric to your west.

rooms.name: Entranceway to the manor
rooms.desc:
The fields of Cedric end here in a small grassy patch before an
iron portcullis to the west which leads into Cedric's castle.  Sturdy
walls of stone run north and south, and above the portcullis lies the
coat of arms of Cedric's family.  Two stone lions flank the gate,
and a smattering of men stand here guarding it.  To the north, south,
and east are the manorial lands of Cedric.

rooms.name: Inside a lordly courtyard
rooms.desc:
You stand within the courtyard of the castle.  The area is abuzz with
merchants, peasants, and tradefolk walking to and fro toward their assorted
tasks.  The courtyard features several small gardens and trees to spruce up
the otherwise cold stone layout.  A stairway leads toward a guard tower above
the portcullis, and doors lead into the castle to the west, north, and east.

rooms.name: A fortified barbican
rooms.desc:
You stand within a barbican constructed over the entranceway into
Cedric's manor.  The room is circular and consists of solid stone,
except for a series of murder holes in the eastern wall which provide
a vantage point for archers to defend against potential attackers.
The furnishings are sparse, in typical military fashion.  Exits lead
north and south along the wall, and a ladder leads down into the courtyard.
Two powerful ballistae have been stationed at large murder holes for defense.

rooms.name: Along a crenellated wall
rooms.desc:
This is a well fortified stretch of wall in Cedric's castle.  Extending
thirty feet over solid ground, the stone walkway offers an unobstructed
view of the lands to the east.  Merlons have been cut into the walls,
offering areas for defenders to fire arrows or drop stones or burning
objects upon besiegers, Upon a pair of parapets, two mangonels
rest in menacing readiness.  The walkway along the wall extends to
guard towers in the north and south.

rooms.name: The Northeastern Guard Tower
rooms.desc:
This is a circular tower of stone, like the seven others posted around
the walls of Cedric's fortified country manor.  Slats in the wall reveal
the meeting of mountains and forest in the distance.  Exits lead
west and south along the wall, and a ladder leads downward.
Someone jotted an interesting carving in the wall with a blade.

rooms.name: On top of the wall
rooms.desc:
This stretch of wall connects the barbican above the portcullis and the
guard tower to the south.  The ramparts are strong here, several layers of
stone able to resist even mangonels.  Although modest in size, Cedric's
quadrangular castle is compact and sturdy.  A sweeping view of
the plains beyond Cedric's walls is offered from this spot.

rooms.name: The Southeastern Guard Tower
rooms.desc:
You stand within a circular tower among the walls of Cedric's
manor.  Sparse surroundings of a table and pair of chairs accompany
the circular room of stone, which features several murder holes for
defenders to view and attack potential attackers.  A ladder leads
down into a storeroom, while exits lead west and north along the walls.

rooms.name: The chapel of Our Lady Saint Torres
rooms.desc:
In the crowded interior of Cedric's manor house, only this humble
space could be spared for worship.  The pews consist of four benches in
two rows, before which a pulpit of carved wood is presided over by the
chaplain. The chapel is modest, with a packed dirt floor and old
pictures of canonized saints hanging about.  The scullery is north,
the courtyard lies south, and a door leads west to
the scalding house.

rooms.name: The scullery room
rooms.desc:
This is just a space used for facilitating the many hard
tasks of the busy kitchen.  Spread about are round basins
of hot water, being scrubbed by maidservants.  Bottles of
agents used for general cleaning lie on crude shelves nailed
into the wall.  A smaller basin of water is filled with
dirty clothes. The scullery opens into the adjacent kitchen
to the west, a ladder leads downward to the larder, and a
door opens south into the chapel.

rooms.name: A bountiful pantry
rooms.desc:
The fruits of Cedric's enforced slave labor abound in this
corner of the manor complex.  Bales of wheat and sacks of oats,
grains, and starches are stacked in a chaotic manner about the
wooden floor, leaving nary a space for proper walking.  There's
enough food here to last the manor for months if besieged.
A pulley and a ladder lead up to the scullery, and doors open
west to the spicery, east to the poultry, and south to the
saucery.

rooms.name: The Saucery
rooms.desc:
This is a small area responsible for the preparation of sauces.  The
ingredients, mixing bowls, and vats of the finished product fill the
meager open spaces of the room.  Kitchen hands scurry about,
assisting the saucerer in preparing for the next feast.  The saucery
smells strongly of ripened herbs, and the air is hot and thick from 
the smoke of boiling gravy.  Doors lead north to the larder, west to
the wine cellar, and east to the poultry.

rooms.name: The Poultry
rooms.desc:
This is where Cedric's favorite food is kept.  The purchase and
preparation of poultry is done here by the poulter.  Chickens hang
in rows along the walls, having been skinned and cleaned.  The room
is kept cool by its subterranean location, preventing the chickens
from spoiling.  Exits lead north to the chandlery and west to the
saucery.

rooms.name: The Chandlery
rooms.desc:
This area in the underbelly of Cedric's manner is responsible for making 
candles, and storing candles and wax.  The air is thick with an 
indistinguishable chemical smell, and dried drops of wax litter the
floor. All manner of candles rest unlit on the walls, ready to be placed in 
candelabra throughout the manor, serving the crucial role of providing light 
in the otherwise dark mansion.  Openings in the wall lead west to the larder 
and south to the poultry.

rooms.name: The Main Kitchen
rooms.desc:
This is one of the larger rooms in Cedric's manor, and the
culmination of the ancillary food preparation rooms.  Here,
the ingredients assembled below are cooked in cauldrons over
open flames and prepared on a long counter by several kitchen
hands.  The floor is tiled, clean, and swept frequently.
    A wonderful assortion of smells waft up from the various
dishes being prepared.  The area is incredibly busy, with
most of the traffic coming and going through the buttery to the
west toward the main dining hall.

rooms.name: The Spicery
rooms.desc:
This is the area from which spices are called by the main chef to
be used in the dish du jour.  Racks and racks of spices, both from
Cedric's fields and imported from abroad, line the walls on all four
sides of this quaint room of wood and dirt.  
The air is resplendent with fragrance from the spice racks,
shifting from an eastern to a northern to a western theme as you
move about the room.  The spices are stored on the racks in small
glass bottles and beneath in large wicker baskets.  A table in the
center of the room serves to apportion the spices as requested by
the chefs above.

rooms.name: A well stocked wine cellar
rooms.desc:
This room abounds in racks of wine, aged to perfection by
years of patience.  Some of finest vines of Cedric and his
ancestors have been resting in the bottles in this cellar for
decades.  Newer choice selections from every season, climate,
and vineyard from across the realm complement the aged wines
in this fine stone cellar, which could well suit the banquet
of any king.  A wooden wine rack rests against the wall.

rooms.name: The Scalding House
rooms.desc:
You stand within a house of blood and meat and carcasses, a
slaughterhouse worthy of simultaneous praise and scorn.
The great animals collected from the plains are butchered
here, sliced up into portions and stored in cooled trunks
in the confines of this already chilly room.  Vents in the
walls prevent putrefication, and monkey boys scurry about,
wiping the blood from the floor and walls.  Doors lead
north and east to the kitchen and chapel.

rooms.name: Along the walls
rooms.desc:
You stand along the crenellated walls of Cedric the Saxon's
manor house.  They tower over the fields below, able to be
easily defended due to their prominence and strength. A
cobbled stone walkway extends east and west toward guard
towers.

rooms.name: Along the walls of Cedric's manor
rooms.desc:
You stand atop a mighty wall of stone which provides the
exterior protection for the manor of Cedric the Saxon.
The ramparts along the walls extend outward to project
maximum firepower upon any besiegers who think themselves
capable of capturing these noble walls.  The walkway
exits into guard towers to the east and west.

rooms.name: A garlic field
rooms.desc:
You stand within an overgrown field of garlic.  Rows and rows
of cloves and those of rose propose to enclose and impose upon
you and those with droves of blows in the pose of grows and not
a bit mo's.  You can walk east to a mushroom pasture, west to a
grassy knoll, or you can just sit here and contemplate being.

rooms.name: The Marshalsea
rooms.desc:
This is the area in Cedric's manor where law and order are centered.
The layout is all business, designed for functionality over comfort.
The floor is cold stone, and a desk rests in the center of the room.
Four jail cells line the western wall, locked tight.  Deputies help
the Marshal to keep track of the prisoners and their sentences.  To
the north, a door opens into the courtyard, and a door also leads
south.

rooms.name: Inside the holding cell
rooms.desc:
This room is filthy and the stale air is rank with the stench of
unwashed men and feces.  Even for a prison cell, this room is
especially offensive to the senses.  Not a single thing has been
provided for the comfort of the men held here; no toilet, nowhere
to rest or sleep, and extremely meager servings of food.  Clearly,
to come afoul of Cedric's temper is a costly choice.

rooms.name: A Peaceful Green Streamside
rooms.desc:
This is a small area of greenery and shade between the manor to the
south and a stream to the north, flowing alongside the mountains. Men
fish along the stream, joking and talking.  Serfs have fallen to
sleep under the cool shade of a few dogwood trees.  You can hear a
gentle tune being played by a duo somewhere nearby with a mandolin
and pan flute.  The smell of flowers, the beauty of light reflecting
off the water, and the grass blowing gently in the wind make you a tad
inclined toward a rest as well.

rooms.name: A mushroom pasture
rooms.desc:
You stand ankle deep within a pasture of many a mushroom,
cultivated for use in local cuisine and export abroad for profit.
The soil is damp, black, and warm from the sun's glow.  The palisade
continues around from the southeast to the northwest, and the
interior of Cedric's manor is barely visible over the stone walls
to the southwest.
